query: MOTS-c[tiab] OR "MOTS c"[tiab] OR MOTSc[tiab] OR "mitochondrial open reading frame of the 12S rRNA"[tiab]
method: Jabbit classified each record from its title, abstract and publication type, then hand-checked every record tagged as human or clinical trial. 'human_measured' = measured natural MOTS-c levels, tissue expression or the m.1382A>C variant in people (some also include animal or cell experiments). 'animal_or_cell' = MOTS-c given to animals or cells, with no human samples reported in the abstract. No record reported giving MOTS-c to a person.
